draw.drawing-tools.select.note: U:quill/draw: wordcraft ribbon/draw.rs and engine/cmd/draw.rs (DrawMode::Select): dragging on the page selects text and drawings again.

draw.drawing-tools.lasso.note: U:quill/draw: Lasso Select: drag a loop round ink and drawings to select them (draw.lasso {page, points}); dragging the selection moves it (draw.lassoMove), the Color menu recolours it (draw.lassoColor).

draw.drawing-tools.eraser.note: U:quill/draw: Eraser: dragging over ink strokes deletes them (draw.erase), each stroke one undo step.

draw.drawing-tools.gallery-pens.note: U:quill/draw: the pens added with Add Pen (ribbon/draw.rs gallery_pen): each tile is its kind's pen drawn in its colour over a bar of its thickness; a click picks it up (draw.usePen {index}), right-click offers Remove Pen (draw.removePen {index}). A fresh profile has Word's default pens (a black, red and blue pen, a pencil and a yellow highlighter: a deliberate deviation, wordcraft 0.13.1 ships an empty gallery), then the person's own: kept per profile in the settings, empty only when every pen was removed.

draw.drawing-tools.add-pen.note: U:quill/draw: a new pen starts as that kind's colour and thickness in use (`current`), joins the gallery and is picked up.

items.label: Theme Colors / Standard Colors / Recent Colors palette

draw.drawing-tools.color.note: U:quill/draw: the colour of the pen in use (and of its gallery pen); with ink lasso-selected the colour goes to the selection's outline instead (draw.lassoColor), as ribbon/draw.rs decides.

draw.drawing-tools.thickness.note: U:quill/draw: the thickness of the pen in use: 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5 and 5 pt for the pen and pencil, 4, 8, 12, 18 and 24 pt for the highlighter.

draw.stencils.ruler.note: U:quill/draw: Word's Ruler stencil has no upstream engine (wordcraft's Draw tab has no Stencils group); hidden.

draw.convert.ink-to-shape.note: U:quill/draw: Ink to Shape: with strokes lasso-selected it converts them (a line and an arrowhead drawn apart become one arrow); otherwise it turns on: strokes drawn from then on that look like a line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, triangle or polygon become that shape.

draw.convert.ink-to-math.note: U:quill/draw: Ink to Math is catalogued upstream with no engine (needs handwriting recognition); hidden.

draw.insert.drawing-canvas.note: U:quill/draw: Insert Drawing Canvas (canvas.rs insert): an empty canvas in line with the text at the caret, selected; it saves to .docx as an empty Word drawing canvas.

draw.replay.ink-replay.note: U:quill/draw: Ink Replay plays the ink back stroke by stroke in the order it was drawn (each stroke keeps its place in that order, also in .docx), then turns itself off.
